shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && echo '--- App.tsx ---' && cat src/App.tsx && echo '--- main.tsx ---' && cat src/main.tsx && echo '--- index.html ---' && cat index.html && echo '--- tsconfig ---' && cat tsconfig.json && echo '--- vite ---' && cat vite.config.ts"
/bin/bash -c "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo '---'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'index' | head"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- Button ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo '--- Select types? ---'; rg -n \"export.*Select\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head"

/bin/bash -c "echo '--- Card ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo '--- Text ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo '--- Flex ---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo '--- Segmented Option ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo '--- types ControlGroupOption ---'; rg -n \"ControlGroupOption\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -5"

/bin/bash -c "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout 2>/dev/null; echo '--- Flex ---'; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- spacing ---'; rg -n \"export.*Flex|export.*Container\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head"

/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(\"                                options={LANGUAGES}\\n\", \"                                options={LANGUAGES.map(({value, label}) => ({value, content: label}))}\\n\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -c "sed -i 's/options={LANGUAGES}/options={LANGUAGES.map(({value, label}) => ({value, content: label}))}/' src/App.tsx
grep -n \"options=\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"
